[LEXP.5.1] First-class set of distance, vector-length, and similarity
primitives. Three sub-families: geometric distances, string
distances, vector similarity. Folded in with the rest of the
expression language so authors have one reference for all
expression-level math. Every function in this section is a member of the
`distance` module, reached through its import ([LIMP.3.3.4]).
